review.algorithm_assessment: Hungarian algorithm on negative weights produces optimal matching and feasible duals. Every alternate optimal matching uses only tight edges. Direct each nonmatched tight edge to the boy owning its girl; a matched edge is replaceable exactly when its boy belongs to an alternating cycle. Bitset transitive closure identifies cycles, yielding intersection of all optimal matchings in O(n^3).
